# Assignment 3 {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note title="Instructions"}

Use **Quarto** or **R Markdown**. Upload **both** files to the **Assignment 3** submission folder on **iCollege**:

1. Your rendered **PDF**, named `A3_LastName_FirstName.pdf`.
2. Its matching source file, named `A3_LastName_FirstName.qmd` or `A3_LastName_FirstName.Rmd`.

The PDF must be generated from the submitted source file. **HTML alone does not satisfy the submission requirement.**

- Put your name and course number at the beginning of the PDF.
- Clearly label every question and subpart.
- Include all R code used to obtain your answers in executable chunks.
- Your source must render from beginning to end without errors. Type mathematical expressions using LaTeX; do not submit screenshots of answers or code.

:::
